BiblicalUsage: Hither is a word that points somewhere close by, and the Bible uses it at moments when someone is being called to come nearer. Moses hears it at the burning bush in Exodus 3:5, Ruth hears it when Boaz invites her to eat in Ruth 2:14, and Samuel hears it when the people ask whether Saul has come in 1 Samuel 10:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God still speaks this way, calling me to come nearer rather than shouting from a distance.
